description: The sign-in commands boopis may run on a form's behalf, by provider id. A form (an agent's, a teammate's, a mod's) names a provider and never a command: the host looks the provider up here and runs exactly this program and argument vector, as a vector, never through a shell. Every entry is a real login command of a tool Hermes or a collection entry uses, checked on the date in `verified` against the sources listed. `program` "hermes" means the Hermes the host runs (its own path and home). Not here yet: `gh auth login` and Hermes's own device-code logins (`hermes auth add nous|openai-codex --type oauth`), because they print a one-time code the user must read while the command runs, and boopis shows a command's output only when it ends. See docs/CONNECTORS.md.

sources: gcloud auth login --help (Google Cloud SDK 570.0.0): `gcloud auth login [ACCOUNT] [--no-activate] [--brief] ...`; the default is a browser flow that returns to a localhost address, so no code is read from the terminal
